behavior.publishingNotifications: Terminal publication outcomes (CONFIRMED -> PUBLISH_SUCCEEDED, REJECTED -> PUBLISH_FAILED) recorded in recordPublicationOutcome atomically create idempotent notifications with category PUBLISH and eventKey publish:<attemptId>:<status>
behavior.aiNotifications: Media generation runtime failures in finish() create notifications with category AI and eventKey ai:<jobId>:failed
behavior.categoryScoping: Notifications list and read-all endpoints support category filtering across RENDER, PUBLISH, and AI categories with atomic acknowledgment
behavior.tests: 20 unit tests in tests/notifications.test.ts covering terminal render triggers, publication confirmed/rejected outcomes, AI generation failures, category filtering, category read-all, duplicate deduplication, tenant isolation, concurrent first-acknowledgement preservation, and atomic failure transactions; all pass locally

limits: In-app notifications only; no external push or email delivery channels
No realtime WebSocket streaming or latency SLO acceptance claimed
Windows environment limits: full Compose verification runs on Linux CI
